# Capability review

**When to load:** Use when a person or the AI has lost track of what Empirica provides, or when deciding what to make more prominent, teach in the instructions, or retire — 'what can Empirica do', 'remind me what's here', 'what am I not using', 'what's worth keeping', 'which commands are dead', 'what should be in the prompt', 'capability review', and before a minor release or once a month. Gives a tour of what is available grouped by the moment it is used, filtered to this practice; measures what is actually used with a census; and proposes keep, make more prominent, demote or retire, each with evidence, for the human to decide. Modes: refresh, usage, assess.

Load this when the question is "what does Empirica do for me", "what are we not using", or "what should go". Even the people who build Empirica forget what it provides (David, 2026-11-20), and a feature nobody remembers is as good as absent; one nobody uses is cost. This skill keeps both visible.
